abstract: Trading regulations are the basis for ensuring the smooth operation of a commodity futures market. Theoretically, the level of the margin requirement directly affects traders’ transaction costs and decisions, which in turn affects commodity futures’ market quality. We take the two adjustments of the margin requirement in China’s new live hog futures market as quasi-natural experiments and examine the impact of the margin requirement adjustment on the market quality of the live hog futures market. Specifically, this paper uses tick-by-tick data to measure market quality and the synthetic control method to conduct causal inference. Our empirical results show that the policy effect of reducing both the margin requirement and price limit at the same time has a more significant impact on market quality than that of reducing the margin requirement alone. The improvement in market activity is particularly significant. Robustness and placebo tests further support our main conclusions, and our findings provide valuable guidance for futures exchanges and regulators in formulating futures trading policies to improve market quality.
abstract_zh: 交易规则是保障商品期货市场平稳运行的基础。理论上，保证金要求的水平直接影响交易者的交易成本和决策，进而影响商品期货的市场质量。本研究将我国新推出的活体生猪期货市场中两次保证金要求的调整视为准自然实验，考察保证金要求调整对活体生猪期货市场质量的影响。具体而言，本文采用逐笔数据衡量市场质量，并运用合成控制法进行因果推断。实证结果表明，同时降低保证金要求和涨跌停板幅度的政策效应，对市场质量的影响比单独降低保证金要求更为显著，其中市场活跃度的提升尤为突出。稳健性检验和安慰剂检验进一步支持了我们的主要结论，研究结果为期货交易所及监管机构制定旨在提升市场质量的期货交易政策提供了有价值的参考。

abstract: Quantitatively analysing the employment impact of economic dual circulation has great practical significance in formulating stable employment policies. However, previous frameworks have failed to consider foreign direct investment (FDI) as an important economic dual circulation carrier. This study develops an economic dual circulation measurement framework by incorporating FDI from the perspective of global value chains (GVCs), using an inter-country input-output model capturing the enterprise ownership heterogeneity. It decomposes economic dual circulation into five routes, and analyses the employment created by China’s economic dual circulation between 2000 and 2020 and its drivers. The major findings are as follows: (1) China has initially become an economy dominated by domestic economic circulation while the international economic circulation via FDI required improvement. (2) Domestic economic circulation was the primary contributor to China’s employment, and the contribution of international economic circulation to employment successively decreased along four routes – traditional trade value chains, trade-related, FDI-related, and mixed GVCs. (3) The major drivers of changes in China’s employment created by economic dual circulation vary with value chain routes and enterprise ownership. These findings are useful for designing policies for unimpeded economic dual circulation and achieving employment stability.
abstract_zh: 定量分析经济双循环的就业效应，对于制定稳定就业政策具有重要的现实意义。然而，以往的分析框架未能将外商直接投资（FDI）视为经济双循环的重要载体。本研究从全球价值链（GVCs）视角出发，通过构建一个捕捉企业所有权异质性的国家间投入产出模型，将FDI纳入经济双循环的测度框架。该框架将经济双循环分解为五条路径，并分析了2000年至2020年间中国经济双循环所创造的就业及其驱动因素。主要研究发现如下：（1）中国已初步形成以国内经济循环为主导的经济格局，而经由FDI的国际经济循环仍有待提升。（2）国内经济循环是中国就业的主要贡献者，而国际经济循环对就业的贡献沿传统贸易价值链、贸易相关、FDI相关及混合全球价值链四条路径依次递减。（3）中国经济双循环所创造就业变动的主要驱动因素因价值链路径及企业所有权性质的不同而有所差异。这些发现对于制定畅通经济双循环、实现就业稳定的政策具有参考价值。

abstract: We analyze optimal budget institutions for local governments in a scenario where local public goods generate positive interregional externalities, such as environmental protection. There is a central government (referred to as the center) and two regions. Each region possesses private information regarding the extent of beneficial spillovers it experiences from the public goods provided by the other region. To achieve constrained efficiency, it is necessary to address these externalities while also tackling the center’s self-selection issue in the presence of asymmetric information. One way to implement the optimal solution under asymmetric information is through a simultaneous-move equilibrium. The center can set a minimum debt level for the region that generates higher spillovers and impose a Pigouvian tax on the region benefiting more from spillovers, subsequently transferring the revenue as a subsidy to the other region. Alternatively, a sequential-move equilibrium can implement the asymmetric information optimum with the additional condition that the follower region’s optimal debt choice is concave in the leader region’s debt choice.
abstract_zh: 我们分析地方政府在地方公共品产生正向跨区域外部性（如环境保护）情境下的最优预算制度。存在一个中央政府（简称中心）和两个地区。每个地区对于从另一地区提供的公共品中获得的有利溢出程度拥有私人信息。为实现受限效率，必须解决这些外部性，同时应对信息不对称条件下中心的自选择问题。在信息不对称下实施最优解的一种方式是通过同时行动均衡。中心可以为产生较高溢出效应的地区设定最低债务水平，并对从溢出中受益更多的地区征收庇古税，随后将税收收入作为补贴转移给另一地区。或者，顺序行动均衡可以在附加条件下实施信息不对称最优解，即跟随地区的最优债务选择是领导地区债务选择的凹函数。
title: Interregional spillovers and optimal budget institutions under asymmetric information
title_zh: 信息不对称下的区域间溢出效应与最优预算制度

abstract: This study examines residents’ willingness to pay (WTP) to preserve the Cultural Landscape of the Old Tea Forests of Jingmai Mountain in China by combining the contingent valuation method (CVM) with fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (FsQCA). CVM results reveal that tea-drinking habits, sustainable intelligence, cultural worldview, nature-centric views, and income positively influence WTP. Mean annual truncated WTP is estimated to be 204 CNY (US$28.18) per resident, yielding an aggregate preservation value of 490.39 million CNY (US$67.73 million). This value is comprised of bequest (58.8%), existence (23.6%), and option value (17.6%). FsQCA identifies two core pathways towards willingness to pay for preservation: (1) nature-centric views combined with high income, and (2) tea-drinking habits, regardless of income level associated with respondents. FsQCA results suggest that cultural factors can partially override income constraints in preservation valuation decisions. Overall results provide a basis for identifying preservation funding targets and reveal that policymakers can enhance WTP through economic development and cultural reinforcement strategies.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过结合条件价值评估法（CVM）与模糊集定性比较分析（FsQCA），探讨了居民对保护中国景迈山古茶林文化景观的支付意愿（WTP）。CVM结果显示，饮茶习惯、可持续智能、文化世界观、自然中心观及收入对支付意愿有正向影响。年均截断支付意愿估计为每位居民204元人民币（约28.18美元），合计保护价值达4.9039亿元人民币（约6773万美元）。该价值由遗赠价值（58.8%）、存在价值（23.6%）和选择价值（17.6%）构成。FsQCA识别出两条通往保护支付意愿的核心路径：（1）自然中心观与高收入相结合；（2）饮茶习惯，不论受访者收入水平如何。FsQCA结果表明，在保护价值评估决策中，文化因素可在一定程度上超越收入限制。总体结果为实现保护资金目标提供了依据，并揭示政策制定者可通过经济发展与文化强化策略提升支付意愿。

abstract: Quantifying the economic impacts of weather variables has been a key empirical topic in understanding the impacts of climate change. While panel methods, which utilize cross-sectional differences in within-unit over-time changes in weather variables, have been widely used to credibly identify the average effect of interest, there has been a growing interest in understanding the distribution of potentially heterogeneous weather effects. The heterogeneity of the effects across space and time, which can shed light on the differences in the local capacity of adaptation across regions or its evolution over time, provides important insights into developing climate policies. In this paper, we propose a novel Bayesian hierarchical modeling approach to estimate heterogeneous effects of weather variables using panel data. Our proposed approach models space–time varying coefficients via Gaussian process priors. Using the data of the corn yield from the US corn belt, we show that our proposed model outperforms several alternatives. Our findings are consistent with the literature and also provide additional insights into the localized nuances of climate change adaptation.
abstract_zh: 量化天气变量的经济影响一直是理解气候变化影响的关键实证课题。尽管利用截面差异中单位内随时间变化的天气变量的面板方法已被广泛用于可信地识别感兴趣的平均效应，但近年来，对于理解潜在异质性天气效应的分布，兴趣日益增长。这些效应在空间和时间上的异质性，能够揭示各地区适应能力的差异或其随时间的演变，为制定气候政策提供了重要见解。本文提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯层次建模方法，利用面板数据估计天气变量的异质性效应。我们提出的方法通过高斯过程先验对时空变化系数进行建模。利用美国玉米带玉米产量的数据，我们展示了所提模型优于几种替代方法。我们的发现与现有文献一致，并为气候变化适应的局部细微差别提供了额外见解。
title: Bayesian space–time varying coefficient modeling for climate econometrics: A spatial–temporal Gaussian process approach
title_zh: 气候计量经济学中的贝叶斯时空变系数建模：一种时空高斯过程方法

abstract: This paper addresses the non-standard problem of detecting multiple structural breaks when the data-generating model in each regime is uncertain, with an application to factor selection in empirical asset pricing. Detection is based on the marginal likelihood of break points, obtained by a novel integration over all possible pairings of models across regimes, from all possible models within regimes. The optimal break points maximize this marginal likelihood. Applying this method to the six Fama–French factors on monthly data from 1963–2023, the analysis identifies three breaks – 1982, 1998, and 2009 – and a shift toward more parsimonious models after 1998. Before 1998, five or six factors are selected, but two afterward. Thus, with breaks, there is a move to parsimony, which has implications for the factor zoo literature. Moreover, within each regime, all omitted factors are spanned by the ones selected. Incorporating breaks also leads to substantially different weight allocations in the maximum Sharpe ratio risk factor portfolio.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当每个制度下的数据生成模型不确定时，检测多重结构断点的非标准问题，并将其应用于实证资产定价中的因子选择。检测基于断点的边际似然，通过一种新颖的积分方法，对所有可能的跨制度模型配对及制度内所有可能的模型进行整合。最优断点最大化这一边际似然。将该方法应用于1963年至2023年月度数据中的六个Fama-French因子，分析识别出三个断点——1982年、1998年和2009年——并观察到1998年后模型趋向更简洁。1998年前，选择五或六个因子，但之后仅选两个。因此，随着断点的出现，模型转向简约，这对因子动物园文献具有启示意义。此外，在每个制度内，所有被省略的因子均被所选因子所涵盖。纳入断点还导致最大夏普比率风险因子组合中的权重分配发生显著变化。
title: Structural breaks, model uncertainty and factor selection
title_zh: 结构突变、模型不确定性与因子选择
